## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:engine` · `area:studio`, into `pm:queue`. `put()` stamps the actor its own header declares

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T13:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** every metadata row reads `created_by` / `updated_by` null, although the repository's header declares `actor → updated_by` and the read side maps it. "Who changed this object?" is answered only by history. objectstack-ai/cloud#2791's acceptance waits on it.
- **Direction:**
  - `SysMetadataRepository.put` stamps `created_by` on insert and `updated_by` on every write from `opts.actor`.
  - A missing actor stays null. ⛔ No placeholder user.
  - Pins:
    - a write with an actor reads it back as `updatedBy` and, for the first write, `created_by`;
    - a write without one reads null;
    - history's `recorded_by` is unchanged.
  - The install request's actor field is a new contract key, so it is ⛔ not here. If wanted, it is its own card.
- Triage: lands in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` (`domain:engine`); rationale: one method honours its declared mapping.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T13:09Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. This amends my grade `6124803255`: `priority:p2` → `priority:p1`.

- objectstack-ai/cloud#2791 is `priority:p1` and is `pm:blocked` on this card. I graded this card without reading that chain.
- Cloud cannot stamp the framework's metadata rows itself, so this card is a wall, and a wall inherits the blocked card's level (`filing-gate.md:42`).
- The direction is unchanged.

File surface (read on `origin/main` `df7a137923`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report). ⛔ Classes, positions and functions only, in every artefact.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`: `SysMetadataRepository.put` stamps `created_by` on insert and `updated_by` on every write, from `opts.actor`, as its header's `actor → updated_by` mapping declares. A missing actor stays null. Any other writer of the parent row in this class that carries an actor is measured and named in the report.
- Tests beside it, with the write door read back through the real repository; one changeset.
- ⛔ Not the install request's actor (a new contract key: its own card, per triage). ⛔ Not the history row's `recorded_by`, which is unchanged.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate).
Clause-②: no
- One method honours its declared mapping. No accept set or export changes.
Responsibility: `SysMetadataRepository.put`, which builds the parent row without the actor and inserts it under `isSystem`, so the engine's stamp has no user either | none: only the history row records the actor | every metadata write with an actor (Studio saves, `/meta` PUT, cloud's AI build agent via `saveMetaItem`); measured by objectstack-ai/cloud#2791
Thread-read: 6124930096
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR edits `sys-metadata-repository.ts`. PR #22962 edits one test file beside it.
- This seat's in-flight #22877 stage 2 may touch this file only where a by-name door needs the member (delete, history, revert lineage). That is a different region from `put`'s row build, and the later lander merges `main`.
- #23027 (`metadata-core`, `runtime`) is disjoint.
